mapper.select: SELECT id FROM biz_free_tag WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_free_tag(name, use_count, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_free_tag SET use_count = use_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_question_free_tag(question_id, tag_id, position) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{tagId}, #{position})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_question_free_tag WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}

SELECT ft.id AS id, ft.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM biz_question_knowledge qk JOIN biz_question_free_tag qft ON qft.question_id = qk.question_id JOIN biz_free_tag ft ON ft.id = qft.tag_id WHERE qk.knowledge_id = #{kpId} GROUP BY ft.id, ft.name ORDER BY cnt DESC, ft.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
